Set `expand=True` on `Table` and `ratio=1` on the Biography column, keeping `no_wrap=True` and `overflow="ellipsis"`; the ratio lets that column take the remaining table width. The [table docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) describe `ratio` and `no_wrap`. For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
